page.layout: One printed page: title page, all lines centred in one column; an engraved emblem (wreath with the words LABOR and CONSTANTIA around a figure) in the middle; imprint below the emblem. Page number "2" at top right.
page.l: Et genere causæ qua ad peccan-
page.notes: The engraving shows a wreath of fruit and foliage with the banner words LABOR and CONSTANTIA around a figure with a spade or stylus over a rectangular plot. The top-right "2" is the printed page number; the ornamental flourish near it is not text. The date cIↄ. Iↄ. XCV. is 1595 in the old reversed-C numerals. Background show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
